=
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE S. B. PD. SINGH

ORAL ORDER 3 10-02-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for O.P. No. 2.
2. The instant application for anticipatory bail filed for the offence punishable under section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. As agreed between both the parties, the matter is referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Center, Patna High Court, Patna for exploring the possibility of amicable settlement of their matrimonial dispute.
Petitioner as well as O.P. No. 2 shall appear in person there on 28th of February, 2025.

4. Put up this case on 28.03.2025 along with the report of Mediation and Conciliation Centre, Patna High Court, Patna.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.69959 of 2024(3) dt.10-02-2025 5.
In the meantime, interim protection given to the petitioner vide order dated 23.10.2024 shall continue till further order.

(S. B. Pd. Singh, J) sushma/-
